assets.title: Rocket League Arena
assets.source: Generated for SuperTurtyBot using the built-in image generation tool
assets.prompt: Generate a believable Rocket League in-game style stadium background, a wide 3:1 panoramic videogame render. Camera at low spectator height near one corner of a regulation rectangular car-soccer pitch, looking diagonally toward ONE orange goal centered in the far end wall. Realistic spatial layout: long side walls and packed stadium grandstands converge toward that far end; the opposite goal is behind the camera and NOT visible. Flat green artificial turf, restrained white field markings, curved plexiglass perimeter and fine hexagonal safety mesh. Enclosed ordinary modern sports stadium, neutral daylight, no fantasy mountains or skyline. Two modestly sized compact rocket-powered sports cars on four wheels near midfield, one blue and one orange, and one metallic paneled soccer ball about 1.3 times car height. Cars and ball small in scene and located along the lower right, with subtle short boost exhaust. Faithful polished game-engine materials and proportions, not exaggerated cinematic concept art, not toy cars, not photoreal road vehicles. Keep central upper half uncluttered. Full rectangular opaque background image, no UI, text, logos, sponsor signage, rounded corners or borders.
assets.transformation: JPEG encoding at original dimensions; crop and shapes rendered in Java
